invariants.note: See perf/README.md §8.1 for the frames_after_idle definition. Missing stays not-evaluable, never 0.

invariants.name: validation_cost_tracks_the_batch_not_the_tree
invariants.note: Validating the construction batch must not walk the retained world. Deliberately a small constant, not a fraction of nodes=10000: a validator that pre-collects world state scales with the tree and fails here while every timing still looks plausible. Missing stays not-evaluable.
